2. (i) The spouse must have been residing with the deceased allottee for at least three years prior to his death and must not have drawn HRA for this period or from date of joining if it is less than 3 years.
3. (ii) The spouse joins Central Government service within two years after the death of the allottee and the accommodation is not vacated.
4. Can an allottee request for a change in accommodation when he has only five months for superannuation? No.
